entities.name: Achaemenid Persian Empire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Achaemenid Persian Empire, a political institution in Uzbekistan during Ancient Sogdia and Transoxiana (550 BCE–330 BCE). Grew from Afrasiab (Maracanda) established — the ancient predecessor of Samarkand and Early Urban Centers and Afrasiab. Led to the emergence of Achaemenid Sogdia.
